newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia July year-on-year manufacturing sales up.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia July year-on-year manufacturing sales up.

text.p: Malaysia's manufacturing sales for July rose 11.3 percent, or 1.5 billion ringgit, from July 1995, the national Bernama news agency reported.
Bernama quoted a Statistics Department report late on Thursday as saying that sales in July 1996 were down two percent to 14.8 billion ringgit from the previous month.
Sales of 58 industries in Malaysia for the first seven months gained 14.8 percent, or 13.1 billion ringgit, compared with the same period last year, the report said.
In the first seven months, semi-conductors and communication equipment and apparatus recorded the largest sales value at 27.791 billion ringgit, up from 23.885 billion ringgit previously.
Other top industries were radio and television set makers, crude oil refineries and motor vehicle manufacturers and assemblers.
A total of 2,590 establishments covered by the survey reported employment of 848,215 workers for July, compared with 778,259 in the same month last year.
